# Bid the run, the copper, and the iron.

> Price a water-softener install from extra pipe past the included run, copper versus PEX, an iron filter or under-sink RO, the brine drain, haul-away of the old unit, and a brine receptacle — not a published $799 installed special. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
